title: The launch was already loaded
instruction: Order the five records by real time. All are Wednesday except the owner’s Monday notice. Dispatch runs 20 minutes fast; other clocks are correct. What was already underway when Rich made his promise?

pieces.label: Public promise — Wednesday 20:00
pieces.detail: Synchronized stream: “No changes before inspection.”

pieces.label: Launch crate enters — Wednesday 20:03
pieces.detail: Correct gate clock. Seal matches the truck manifest.

pieces.label: Truck departs — Wednesday 20:12
pieces.detail: Fast dispatch clock. Loaded with the launch crates.

hints: Subtract twenty minutes from both dispatch entries.
The truck left at 19:52, before the 20:00 promise.
solvedText: Order at 19:30, truck away at 19:52, promise at 20:00, crates through the gate at 20:03. The loading plan was already in motion; the matching seal connects it to Rich’s equipment.

chapter: Chapter Thirteen: Museum of the Block
title: The rail in five photographs
instruction: Order the five repair records by what physically changed. These photographs have no reliable timestamps. Bolt holes and primer remain visible in later stages; nobody removes or repaints them.

Follow P4, then C9, then W2, then B7.

title: The Reel Timeline
instruction: Order by actual time. Lobby clock and hallway camera are five minutes fast; courier and witness phones are correct. Use what the records show, not the order someone handed them over.

pieces.label: Hallway frame
pieces.detail: 18:07, hallway camera: Promoter carries the rattling plinth. Camera is five minutes fast.

pieces.detail: 18:00, lobby clock: power notice posted. The lobby clock is five minutes fast.

pieces.detail: 18:04, synchronized phone: film leader protrudes from the plinth’s loose bottom panel.

pieces.label: Station whistle — 9:14

pieces.detail: Bakery clock. Van enters the loading bay; parcel seal is intact.

pieces.label: River bell — 9:02
pieces.detail: River clock. The delivery cart passes the bell with no parcel.

Convert the two bakery readings first. The shutter is 9:00; the mirror sighting is 9:05.
solvedText: The parcel reached the kiosk at 9:05, two minutes before the alleged train trip began. Compare its serial number with both invoices next.

title: Rebuild the unclocked route
instruction: Order all six stops from station to river. Each was visited once. The damaged cart could not reverse on a narrow ramp. Use the witnesses together; no single witness saw the whole trip.

pieces.label: Station
pieces.detail: Departure point. The cart had clean wheels here.

pieces.label: Ticket kiosk
pieces.detail: The last dry wheel print is here, immediately before the river.

pieces.label: Laundromat
pieces.detail: The driver visited immediately before the tower.

pieces.label: Clock tower

pieces.label: Bakery

Tower is fourth. Laundromat has to be third.

title: The file plays backward
instruction: The six word-splices are backward. Decode them, then build the instruction. The engineer confirms the place is called STUDIO THREE, and the object is a KEY. Nothing is hidden under the whole building.

pieces.label: YEK
pieces.detail: A physical object, not a musical pitch.

pieces.label: OIDUTS
pieces.detail: Part of a two-word room name.

pieces.label: DNIF
pieces.detail: Reverse the characters; this is an instruction.

pieces.label: EERHT
pieces.detail: Part of the same room name.

pieces.detail: Spaces are tape damage. Join, then reverse.

pieces.label: W O L E B
pieces.detail: Spaces are tape damage. Join, then reverse.

hints: Remove stray spaces before reversing. The phrase begins FIND KEY.
Read it as FIND KEY / BELOW DESK / STUDIO THREE.
solvedText: FIND KEY BELOW DESK, STUDIO THREE. A location we can inspect—not proof of who left the message.

title: Do not feed the weather back into itself
instruction: Build one signal path from microphone to antenna using all six components. Match socket codes, not similar-looking names. A connection must use the output of one piece and the input of the next.

pieces.label: Microphone
pieces.detail: OUT M2. No input.

pieces.label: Preamp
pieces.detail: IN M2 → OUT L7.

pieces.label: Recorder
pieces.detail: IN L7 → OUT D4. The label “amplifier” has been crossed out.

pieces.detail: IN H1. No output.

pieces.label: Modulator
pieces.detail: IN D4 → OUT R9.

Recorder accepts L7, not R9; the amplifier belongs near the antenna.

title: Four rooms, four takes
instruction: Place the witnesses under Studios A, B, C, D, left to right. A has a fan; B has a clock; C has rain against glass; D is soundproof. Studio A’s clock had been removed that morning.

pieces.label: Watson
pieces.detail: No ticking in my take. I was not in the silent room or the room with an outside window.

pieces.label: Alice
pieces.detail: Mine was not soundproof. Neither mechanical noise is on my take.

pieces.label: Streamer’s friend
pieces.detail: My take contains no fan, clock, or rain.

pieces.label: Cornball
pieces.detail: My room had a mechanical background sound. Watson had the other mechanical room.

hints: Place the silent take first, then eliminate rooms for Alice.
Watson must be A. Cornball takes the remaining mechanical room, B.

title: Everybody remembers being VIP
instruction: Rebuild five seats from left to right, facing the stage. Only seats 2, 3, and 4 had a direct view; the end seats faced mirrors. “Beside” means immediately adjacent.

pieces.label: Watson

pieces.label: Alice

pieces.label: Cornball
pieces.detail: Alice and Promoter were my two neighbors.

Cornball must be in the middle, with Alice on his left.

title: Six stops and a wet transfer

title: One battery, no second chances
instruction: Arrange all five bridge operations. The battery is connected once and stays on. Use the interlocks printed on the controls; an unsafe operation cannot be undone.

pieces.label: Connect power
pieces.detail: No prerequisite. Every other control needs power.

pieces.label: Depart

pieces.detail: Only after road traffic stops. Boarding through a closed gate is impossible.

pieces.detail: Passengers board through the raised gate. With their weight aboard, perform the stationary brake test.

title: He moved the windows again

pieces.label: Tin Man — heart

title: Do not shrink without the key

title: Build the Last Waffle
instruction: Rebuild the kitchen log from first action to last. Start with a cold, empty iron and an empty plate. Each action happens once. Follow the requirements printed on the tickets; nothing happens offscreen.

pieces.detail: Syrup goes only on the cooked waffle after it reaches the plate.

title: The Feather File
instruction: Put the five camera events in real chronological order, earliest to latest. All stamps are from the same night. Each camera’s clock error is printed on its evidence card: subtract a fast clock’s error; add a slow clock’s error. Use every event once.
